title: Approximate tangent spaces are transported by affine isometries
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, S a subset of R^(n+l), z, xi in R^(n+l), Q a linear isometry equivalence of R^(n+l), and P a linear subspace. If P is the approximate tangent space of S at z in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4 (Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S z P), then Q(P) = Submodule.map Q P is the approximate tangent space of A(S) at A(z), where A(w) := xi + Q w.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (S : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (z ξ : Amb n ℓ) (Q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S z P → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n ((fun w => ξ + Q w) '' S) (ξ + Q z) (Submodule.map Q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap P)
